Notice: This PR is currently blocked by #377948.

This adds an option programs.fish.functions, to specify user-defined functions that should be available in the system-wide configuration. The code is taken from home-manager, but would also be useful for nixpkgs.

This is my first time contributing to nixpkgs, and still relatively new to Nix stuff. Feedback and guidance would be welcome!

items.content_html:
Motivation for this change

Make the behavior of command-not-found more consistent between NIX_AUTO_RUN on and off.

Which means, when NIX_AUTO_RUN set on, execute the command directly, and when NIX_AUTO_RUN set off, print the command to execute, not just print the command to enter a shell which contains the expected command in PATH.
